lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha One, Babylon Control. Bay doors are open. Your check pilot launches first, then you.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Alpha One, {instructor}. I am your check pilot today. Two ships, you and me. See you outside.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: We hold here, eight kilometres off the station, clear of traffic. You are at rest. Handling first.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Do each check as I call it. There is no fail. If you miss one I call it again, then I show you.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Auto-track is on. It holds your nose on your target, so you cannot turn. Switch it off.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Pitch. Bring the nose up or down, forty-five degrees.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Yaw. Swing the nose left or right, forty-five degrees.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Roll. Half a turn, either way.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Now thrust. Main pods: fire both and build forward speed.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Retros. Fire both and take that speed off.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Strafe left. Slide the ship, nose held.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Strafe right.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Strafe up.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Strafe down.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Flight assist off. The ship now keeps whatever motion you give it.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Feel that drift. Assist off, you can turn and keep your heading of travel. Guns on a target while you slide past it.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Flight assist on. The computer holds your nose and your speed again.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Brake. Hold it until you are at rest.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: That is handling. You fly her clean.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Now your views and your lights. You have two views, cockpit and chase.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Switch to the chase view. You see your ship from outside.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Switch to the cockpit view. You fight from in here.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Free look. Hold it and look around you.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Running lights. Switch them. Traffic sees you by them.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Your X control. A tap tracks your target: the ship turns to follow it. A hold runs what the target offers, when you are in reach.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: A jumpgate offers a jump. A docking bay offers docking. X will do more as you meet new places.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Open the target menu. Hold the target control and pick NAV ONE.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Tap X. Auto-track the buoy.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Buoy course. Five buoys, in order, each inside two hundred metres. The clock starts as you pass NAV ONE.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Watch the approach cue under your target. When it says brake, brake. Overshoot costs you time.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: NAV ONE is your start. In your own time.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Clock is running. NAV TWO.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: That time is as good as mine. Keep this up and one day you might be flying a White Star.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Solid time. On the standard. Keep working your braking points.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: You got round. Slowly. My grandmother brakes later than that, and she flies a desk.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: You destroyed a navigation buoy. Fly like that and you are lucky to end up piloting a rusty cargo ship.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Gunnery. Control is releasing unarmed target drones into the box. They do not shoot back.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Tap the target control. Take the nearest drone, then the next.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Put your guns on the lead reticle, not on the drone. The reticle is where your bolts will meet it.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Fire mode. Switch your guns to linked: all four together.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Now alternating: one pair, then the other. A steadier stream.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Weapons free. Destroy the drones.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: All three down. Nice gunnery.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Wing orders. A squadron leader commands a flight of two wingmen. For this drill I am your wingman. Orders are on the comms menu.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Order me to form on you.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Two more drones. Target one, then order me to attack your target. I take that one only.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Your target is down. The other drone is yours if you want the practice. Control recalls it when we move on.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Order me to cover you. I take whoever attacks you.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Drill over. I am your instructor again. Next, the station: know what you defend.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Come to rest for the tour. Brake and hold.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: The Cobra bays. Each arm holds a wing of Starfuries. You launched from Alpha's.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: The main docking bay, on the axis. Ships enter one at a time, on Control's word. You dock here for repair.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: The command section, above the bay. Babylon Control works from there.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: The defense grid. Light turrets and interceptor batteries along the hull. Interceptors stop incoming fire.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Heavy cannons, for capital ships. The grid defends the station. It does not chase.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Last stop, the jumpgate, fifty kilometres out. I will lead.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Target the jumpgate first. Open the target menu and pick it.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Good, you have it. Fly the approach cue: build speed, then brake when it calls. The gate takes you from inside its reach.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Hold X to run what your target offers.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: The gate is offering the jump. Hold X now. The autopilot flies you in.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: And out through the blue vortex. That was your first jump here. Nothing left on my list, Alpha One. Home.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: All ships, Babylon Control. Unscheduled jumpgate activation. Raiders, six fighters, out of the gate. This is not a drill.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Check is suspended, Alpha One. This is real. I am on your wing. Weapons free.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha One, Control. Alpha wing is launching, all flights. Alpha Two and Alpha Three are your wingmen. Hold the raiders off the gate run until they reach you.

lines.speaker: alpha_2
lines.text: Alpha Two, launching. On our way to you, Lead.

lines.speaker: alpha_3
lines.text: Alpha Three, clear of the bay. Forming on Alpha Two.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Jump point forming off the station. Raider strike carrier. It is launching fighters, eight more.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: A pirate drive takes four minutes to recharge after a jump. Until then that carrier cannot jump out. That is your window.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha One, the carrier may run for the jumpgate instead. Stay on it and it cannot.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha One, Control. You are damaged. The main docking bay is clear for you. Dock for repair, then relaunch.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha One, repairs complete. You are launched. Rejoin your flight.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: The raider carrier is destroyed. Good kill, Alpha.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: All ships, Babylon Control. The raid is over. Stand down from alert. Traffic may resume.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Alpha One, {instructor}. That was no part of today's check. Here is my read on it.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Every Starfury came home. A perfect score, in my book.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: One Starfury did not come back. You kept the rest together under fire.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: We lost pilots out there. Give your orders sooner and hold your flight close.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Transports died on the gate run. Guarding them was our job.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: The carrier is scrap, caught before its drive came back. That goes on your record.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: The carrier slipped out. No mark against you: the squadron matters more.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: An exemplary course, then a real fight handled like that. You are squadron leader, as of now.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: You are on the squadron roster. Keep this up and you will lead it before long.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha One, Control. Welcome to Babylon 5.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha One is down. All flights, Control has the squadron.

lines.speaker: instructor
lines.text: Watch me. I will fly it.
